title: PaveLedger contract import
description: One object per contractor contract. Up to 200 rows per import. The same field names are used as CSV/Excel headers and XML element names. Rows matching an existing contract on firm, road, start and end are skipped as duplicates.

contractor.title: Contractor firm
contractor.description: Registered name of the firm. Use the same spelling every time so its contracts group together.

road.title: Road name
road.description: Main street or road the warranty covers, spelled exactly as in tickets.

start.title: Warranty begins
start.description: First day of the warranty period. YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY.

end.title: Warranty ends
end.description: Last day of the warranty period. YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY.

poc.title: Point of contact
poc.description: Person at the firm who receives repair notices.

email.title: Contact email
email.description: Where repair notices are sent. Check it carefully.

scope.title: Work scope
scope.description: What the warranty covers on that road, such as a section, lanes or chainage.
examples: Kolovoz od raskrsnice sa ul. Omladinska do mosta, obe trake

additionalRoads.title: Additional streets
additionalRoads.description: Other streets covered by the same contract.

addressCountry.title: Country or region
addressCountry.description: Country of the firm address. Leave empty if unknown. SRB, EU, USA, CAN (also accepts Srbija, Serbia, RS, Europe, Canada).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Internal notes, such as the contract number.

scopeLat.title: Area latitude
scopeLat.description: Centre of the covered area on the map. Use together with longitude and radius.

scopeLng.title: Area longitude
scopeLng.description: Centre of the covered area on the map.

scopeRadius.title: Area radius (m)
scopeRadius.description: Radius around the centre. Tickets inside it are matched to this contract.
